title: JSON Formatter & Beautifier
description: Format, beautify, and validate JSON data online. Free, fast, privacy-focused — no data is sent to any server.

faq.question: What is a JSON formatter?
faq.answer: A JSON formatter is a free online tool that formats, beautifies, and validates JSON data. It makes raw JSON data readable with proper indentation and syntax highlighting.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. All formatting happens entirely in your browser. No data is sent to any server.

faq.question: Is this tool free?
faq.answer: Yes, completely free with no usage limits.

title: Base64 Encoder & Decoder
description: Encode and decode Base64 strings online. Free, fast, privacy-focused — all operations run in your browser.

faq.question: What is Base64?
faq.answer: Base64 is an encoding scheme that represents binary data in an ASCII string format. It's commonly used for encoding data in URLs, email attachments, and data URIs.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. All encoding and decoding happens entirely in your browser. No data is sent to any server.

faq.question: Can I encode files?
faq.answer: Yes, you can paste file contents or drag-and-drop small files for encoding.

title: MD5 Hash Generator
description: Generate MD5 hash values for text online. Fast and secure — all computations run in your browser.

faq.question: What is MD5?
faq.answer: MD5 is a widely used hash function that converts data of arbitrary length into a fixed-length 128-bit hash value.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. All hash computations happen entirely in your browser. No data is sent to any server.

faq.question: Is MD5 secure?
faq.answer: MD5 has known collision vulnerabilities and should not be used for security-sensitive purposes like password storage. Consider SHA-256 or stronger algorithms.

title: Regex Tester
description: Test and validate regular expressions online. Real-time matching, highlight display, supports multiple programming language syntaxes.

faq.question: What is a regular expression?
faq.answer: A regular expression (regex) is a text pattern used for matching, searching, and replacing specific patterns in strings.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. All regex matching happens entirely in your browser. No data is sent to any server.

faq.question: Which programming language syntax is supported?
faq.answer: Supports regex syntax for JavaScript, Python, Java, PHP, Ruby, and other popular languages.

title: URL Encoder & Decoder
description: Encode and decode URL strings online. Supports percent-encoding and UTF-8 characters.

faq.question: What is URL encoding?
faq.answer: URL encoding (also called percent-encoding) converts special characters into %XX format for safe transmission in URLs.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. All encoding and decoding happens entirely in your browser. No data is sent to any server.

faq.question: Does it support non-ASCII characters?
faq.answer: Yes, using UTF-8 encoding to correctly handle Chinese, emoji, and other Unicode characters.

title: HTML Escape & Unescape
description: Escape and unescape HTML special characters online. Prevent XSS attacks and protect web application security.

faq.question: What is HTML escaping?
faq.answer: HTML escaping converts special characters like <, >, &, and " into HTML entities to prevent XSS attacks.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. All escaping operations happen entirely in your browser. No data is sent to any server.

faq.question: Which characters are supported?
faq.answer: Supports all HTML special characters including <, >, &, ", ', and Unicode characters.

title: Timestamp Converter
description: Convert Unix timestamps to human-readable dates and vice versa. Supports seconds and milliseconds with live clock display.

faq.question: What is a Unix timestamp?
faq.answer: A Unix timestamp is the number of seconds elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC (the Unix epoch).

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. All time conversions happen entirely in your browser. No data is sent to any server.

faq.question: Which formats are supported?
faq.answer: Supports Unix timestamps (seconds and milliseconds), ISO 8601, UTC time, and other common formats.

title: UUID v4 Generator
description: Generate random UUID v4 online. Compliant with RFC 4122 standard, guaranteed uniqueness.

faq.question: What is a UUID?
faq.answer: A UUID (Universally Unique Identifier) is a 128-bit identifier used to uniquely identify information in distributed systems.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. All UUID generation happens entirely in your browser. No data is sent to any server.

faq.question: How secure is UUID v4?
faq.answer: UUID v4 uses random number generation with an extremely low collision probability (~2^-122), suitable for most use cases.
